Chromatic.description: Descended from chaotic or brutal dragon types like Red, Blue, or Black, wielding raw, elemental fury.

features.name: Chromatic Warding
features.tldr: You can temporarily immunize yourself to the damage type associated with your chromatic ancestry.

Metallic.description: Descended from noble and righteous dragon types like Gold, Silver, or Bronze, wielding protective or coercive presence.

features.name: Metallic Breath Weapons
features.tldr: You gain access to a secondary specialized breath weapon that can push targets back or incapacitate them.
